name: 在产工单数
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
formula: 工单状态为 in_progress(进行中) 的工单数
description: 当前处于「进行中(in_progress)」状态的工单数量（口径：mes_work_order.order_status = 'in_progress'；枚举 closed 已关闭/completed 已完成/in_progress 进行中/released 已下达）

name: 已完成工单数
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
formula: 工单状态为 completed(已完成) 的工单数
description: 已完成的工单数量（口径：mes_work_order.order_status = 'completed'）

name: 已取消工单数
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
formula: 工单状态为 closed(已取消/已关闭) 的工单数
description: 已取消/已关闭的工单数量（口径：mes_work_order.order_status = 'closed'；枚举 closed 已取消 72/completed 已完成 207/in_progress 进行中 33/released 已下达 32）

name: 返工数量
sql_expression: SUM(COALESCE(rework_qty, 0))
formula: SUM(rework_qty)
description: 返工数量合计（口径：mes_process_output.rework_qty 求和；yans 库实测该列存在，个别行可能为空用 COALESCE 兜底）

name: 库存缺口量
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) AND available_qty < safety_stock_qty THEN safety_stock_qty - available_qty ELSE 0 END)
formula: 最新快照日，仅统计 available_qty < safety_stock_qty 的行，合计 (安全库存 - 可用库存)；不缺货行计 0
description: 库存缺口合计（口径：**最新快照日**里低于安全库存的行求和 safety_stock_qty - available_qty，正值表示缺口）。2026-10-04 修复：原表达式不带日期条件，而 inv_inventory_snapshot 是每日快照表（yans 45 个快照日）→ 同一产品的缺口会按它在快照表里出现的天数被**重复累加**（与「库存预警数」同型 bug）。当前演示库无低于安全线的行，故修复前后都是 0，属潜伏问题；但一旦出现缺货行就会按 45 倍放大。

name: 库存分档统计
aliases: 可用量与安全库存的差距分档
formula: 以每个产品最新快照（snapshot_date 最大）为准，库存水平 r = available_qty / safety_stock_qty；分档：r<1 缺货；1≤r<1.5 正常；r≥1.5 过剩（1.5 为默认业务阈值，可调整）。各档产品数 = 档内 COUNT(DISTINCT product_id)。SQL 骨架：WITH last AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id) * FROM inv_inventory_snapshot ORDER BY product_id, snapshot_date DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN available_qty < safety_stock_qty THEN '缺货' WHEN available_qty < safety_stock_qty * 1.5 THEN '正常' ELSE '过剩' END 档位, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) 产品数 FROM last GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
description: 库存水平分档统计：按每产品最新快照的可用量/安全库存比值分 缺货/正常/过剩 三档，统计各档产品数。（演示库 2026-07-15 最新快照 28 个产品比值 2.25~3.57，全部落在『过剩』档。）
exec_sql: WITH last AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id) * FROM inv_inventory_snapshot ORDER BY product_id, snapshot_date DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN available_qty < safety_stock_qty THEN '缺货' WHEN available_qty < safety_stock_qty * 1.5 THEN '正常' ELSE '过剩' END AS "档位", COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS "产品数" FROM last GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: 工单产出缺口
formula: 完工数量 = 工单在末道工序（dim_process.process_seq 最大的记录，如 PR08 包装入库）的 good_qty；严禁 SUM(good_qty)——mes_process_output 每工单含 8 条工序记录，SUM 会把产出放大约 8 倍。产出缺口 = plan_qty − 完工数量。缺口最大前 N 个工单 = 缺口降序 LIMIT N（正=欠产，≤0=完成/超产）。SQL 骨架：WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT w.work_order_no, w.plan_qty, l.good_qty 完工数量, (w.plan_qty - l.good_qty) 缺口 FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id = w.work_order_id AND l.rn = 1 ORDER BY 缺口 DESC LIMIT N
description: 工单产出缺口（末工序完工口径）：完工数量取该工单末道工序（process_seq 最大）良品数，缺口 = 计划量 − 完工数量；用于「产出缺口最大的前10个工单」类查询。（演示库 344 张工单全部欠产，缺口 0~535；缺口最大 MO-20260610-0069 = 535。）
exec_sql: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT w.work_order_no AS "工单号", w.plan_qty AS "计划数量", l.good_qty AS "完工数量", (w.plan_qty - l.good_qty) AS "产出缺口" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id = w.work_order_id AND l.rn = 1 ORDER BY "产出缺口" DESC LIMIT {limit}

name: 超产工单数
formula: 完工数量 = 工单在末道工序（dim_process.process_seq 最大的记录）的 good_qty（严禁 SUM(good_qty)，每工单 8 条工序记录会放大约 8 倍致全超产假象）。超产工单 = 完工数量 > plan_qty；超产工单数 = 满足条件工单的 COUNT。SQL 骨架：WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT COUNT(*) 超产工单数 FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id = w.work_order_id AND l.rn = 1 WHERE l.good_qty > w.plan_qty
description: 超产工单数（末工序完工口径）：完工数量超过计划量的工单数，与『工单产出缺口』同源口径。（演示库 344 张工单全部欠产，当前超产工单数 = 0。）
exec_sql: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "超产工单数" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id = w.work_order_id AND l.rn = 1 WHERE l.good_qty > w.plan_qty

name: 产线不良数
sql_expression: SUM(COALESCE(defect_qty, 0))
formula: 产线不良数 = mes_process_output.defect_qty 按产线求和（产线经 dim_production_line.line_id 关联），排行按不良数降序。
description: 各产线工序不良数合计与排行（不良来源=mes_process_output.defect_qty 工序不良，非 qms_defect_detail 检验缺陷明细；基准：一车间-4号线 22690 最高）。

name: 待生产工单数
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'released' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
formula: 待生产工单数 = mes_work_order.order_status='released' 的工单数（已下达但尚未开工）。
description: 已下达/等待生产状态的工单数（order_status='released'；yans 库实测 32 单）。用于「等待生产的工单数量」「处于已下达状态的工单有多少」类问法。

name: 一次直通率
sql_expression: (SUM(COALESCE(input_qty, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(rework_qty, 0))) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(input_qty), 0)
formula: 一次直通率 FPY = (投入量 − 返工量) / 投入量 × 100% ＝ 100% − 返工率。与已注册的「良率」(合格数/投入数) 【不是】同一指标，严禁互相冒充。
description: 一次直通率（FPY）：未经返工直接通过的比例（口径：(input_qty − rework_qty) / input_qty；演示库全期各产线 98.94~99.27，一车间-1号线 99.27 最高）。⚠️ 禁止用 good_qty/input_qty 冒充——那是「良率」(97.05~97.95)，两者相差约 1.2 个百分点。

name: 计划达成率
formula: 计划达成率 = 末道工序完工数量 / 计划数量 × 100%。完工数量 = 工单在末道工序（dim_process.process_seq 最大的记录）的 good_qty，按所选维度（产线/车间/产品/日期/整体）分组聚合。⚠️ 严禁 order_status='completed' 计数当分子，严禁 SUM(good_qty)（8 道工序记录放大约 8 倍）。
description: 计划达成率（末工序完工口径，确定性执行）：按问题维度自动选择人工验证模板（exec_sql_by_dim）。yans 全期基准：一车间-1号线 80.90 / 二车间-5号线 80.34 / 二车间-2号线 78.77 / 三车间-3号线 76.87 / 一车间-4号线 75.19 / 全厂 78.31。yans 的 mes_work_order **没有 actual_qty 列**，任何引用它的写法都会执行失败。

exec_sql_by_dim.产线: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT pl.line_name AS "产线", SUM(l.good_qty)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(w.plan_qty),0) AS "计划达成率" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.rn=1 JOIN dim_production_line pl ON pl.line_id=w.line_id GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY "计划达成率" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.车间: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT pl.workshop_name AS "车间", SUM(l.good_qty)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(w.plan_qty),0) AS "计划达成率" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.rn=1 JOIN dim_production_line pl ON pl.line_id=w.line_id GROUP BY pl.workshop_name ORDER BY "计划达成率" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.产品: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT p.product_name AS "产品", SUM(l.good_qty)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(w.plan_qty),0) AS "计划达成率" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.rn=1 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id=w.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY "计划达成率" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.日期: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT to_char(w.end_date,'YYYY-MM') AS "月份", SUM(l.good_qty)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(w.plan_qty),0) AS "计划达成率" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.rn=1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
exec_sql_by_dim._default: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT SUM(l.good_qty)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(w.plan_qty),0) AS "计划达成率" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.rn=1

name: 满足安全库存品种数
aliases: 有多少产品满足安全库存
几个产品满足安全库存
哪些产品满足安全库存
sql_expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) AND available_qty >= safety_stock_qty THEN product_id END)
formula: 最新快照日 available_qty >= safety_stock_qty 的去重产品数
description: 当前满足安全库存的品种数（口径：最新快照日达标产品去重计数；yans 基准 20 种，2026-07-15 快照 20 个产品全部达标）。注：v1 按快照行计数(1004) 名实不符，2026-09-25 审计修正为品种口径。
exec_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS "满足安全库存品种数" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) AND i.available_qty >= i.safety_stock_qty

name: 当前库存量
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) THEN available_qty ELSE 0 END)
formula: 最新快照日的 available_qty 合计（每个产品/仓库各取最新一条快照）
description: 当前时点可用库存（口径：取最新快照日 available_qty 求和；yans 基准 72961，2026-07-15）。与「库存量」（全历史快照累计 3366671）相差约 46 倍，问「当前/还剩多少库存」必须用本口径。
exec_sql: SELECT p.product_name AS "产品", i.available_qty AS "当前库存" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) ORDER BY i.available_qty DESC

exec_sql_by_dim.仓库: SELECT i.warehouse_code AS "仓库", SUM(i.available_qty) AS "当前库存" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) GROUP BY i.warehouse_code ORDER BY "当前库存" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.产品: SELECT p.product_name AS "产品", i.available_qty AS "当前库存" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) ORDER BY i.available_qty DESC
exec_sql_by_dim._default: SELECT p.product_name AS "产品", i.available_qty AS "当前库存" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) ORDER BY i.available_qty DESC

name: 当前总库存量
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) THEN available_qty + COALESCE(frozen_qty,0) ELSE 0 END)
formula: 最新快照日的 (available_qty + frozen_qty) 合计
description: 当前时点总库存（口径：取最新快照日 可用+冻结 求和；yans 基准 73781，2026-07-15）。与「总库存」（全历史快照累计 3406851）区分。
exec_sql: SELECT SUM(i.available_qty + COALESCE(i.frozen_qty,0)) AS "当前总库存" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot)

exec_sql_by_dim.仓库: SELECT i.warehouse_code AS "仓库", SUM(i.available_qty + COALESCE(i.frozen_qty,0)) AS "当前总库存" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) GROUP BY i.warehouse_code ORDER BY "当前总库存" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.产品: SELECT p.product_name AS "产品", SUM(i.available_qty + COALESCE(i.frozen_qty,0)) AS "当前总库存" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY "当前总库存" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim._default: SELECT SUM(i.available_qty + COALESCE(i.frozen_qty,0)) AS "当前总库存" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot)

name: 完工数量
formula: 完工数量 = 工单在末道工序（dim_process.process_seq 最大的记录）的 good_qty 合计；严禁 SUM(good_qty)（每工单 8 条工序记录会放大约 8 倍）。
description: 完工数量（末工序完工口径，确定性执行）：yans 全期基准 345198 件；产线最高 三车间-3号线 73721。与「产量」(good+defect 全工序合计) 不是同一指标，严禁互相冒充。

exec_sql_by_dim.产线: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT pl.line_name AS "产线", SUM(l.good_qty) AS "完工数量" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.rn=1 JOIN dim_production_line pl ON pl.line_id=w.line_id GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY "完工数量" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.车间: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT pl.workshop_name AS "车间", SUM(l.good_qty) AS "完工数量" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.rn=1 JOIN dim_production_line pl ON pl.line_id=w.line_id GROUP BY pl.workshop_name ORDER BY "完工数量" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.产品: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT p.product_name AS "产品", SUM(l.good_qty) AS "完工数量" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.rn=1 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id=w.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY "完工数量" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.日期: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT to_char(w.end_date,'YYYY-MM') AS "月份", SUM(l.good_qty) AS "完工数量" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.rn=1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
exec_sql_by_dim._default: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT SUM(l.good_qty) AS "完工数量" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.rn=1

name: 欠产工单数
formula: 欠产工单 = 末道工序完工数量 < plan_qty 的工单；口径与「超产工单数」互补（完工=计划 既不超也不欠）。
description: 欠产工单数（末工序完工口径，确定性执行）：yans 全期基准 344 单（全部工单均欠产，超产 0 单）。
exec_sql: WITH lastp AS (SELECT x.work_order_id, x.good_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_order_id ORDER BY pr.process_seq DESC) rn FROM mes_process_output x JOIN dim_process pr ON x.process_id = pr.process_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "欠产工单数" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN lastp l ON l.work_order_id = w.work_order_id AND l.rn = 1 WHERE l.good_qty < w.plan_qty

name: 漏检工单数
formula: 漏检工单 = mes_work_order 中不存在任何 qms_inspection 检验记录（按 work_order_id 关联）的工单。
description: 漏检工单数（确定性执行）：yans 全期基准 0 单（344 张工单全部有检验记录）；该口径用于「有没有工单没做质检」类问法，换库后未必为 0。
exec_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "漏检工单数" FROM mes_work_order w WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qms_inspection q WHERE q.work_order_id = w.work_order_id)

name: 停机设备数
sql_expression: COUNT(DISTINCT equipment_id)
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT equipment_id)
description: 发生过停机记录的设备台数（口径：eqp_downtime_record 去重 equipment_id；yans 基准 40 台 / 设备台账共 48 台）。

name: 严重缺陷占比
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN severity_level IN ('critical','major') THEN COALESCE(defect_qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(defect_qty, 0)), 0)
formula: Σ(severity_level ∈ {critical, major} 的 defect_qty) / Σ(全部 defect_qty) × 100%
description: 严重及以上缺陷件数占比（口径：critical+major 件数 / 全部缺陷件数；yans 基准 63.64%，缺陷件数总计 5273）。2026-09-29 口径统一后，内置「严重缺陷数」已同步改为 critical+major，两者分子口径一致（可直接用 严重缺陷数 ÷ 缺陷件数 复算）；只要 critical 单等级请用「致命缺陷数」。

name: 平均日产量
sql_expression: SUM(COALESCE(good_qty, 0) + COALESCE(defect_qty, 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT stat_date), 0)
formula: Σ(good_qty + defect_qty) / 去重统计日数（与内置「产量」同分子口径）
description: 平均每个统计日的产量（口径：与内置「产量」同分子 good+defect，除以 COUNT(DISTINCT stat_date)；yans 基准 71130.16 件/日，统计期 2026-06-01~07-15 共 45 天）。

name: 平均工单计划量
aliases: 平均每张工单计划生产多少
sql_expression: AVG(plan_qty)
formula: AVG(plan_qty)
description: 单张工单的平均计划产量（口径：mes_work_order.plan_qty 简单平均；yans 基准 1281.40 件/单，工单共 344 张）。

name: 工单完成率
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
formula: 已完成工单数 / 工单总数 × 100%
exec_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "工单完成率" FROM mes_work_order
exec_sql_by_dim: SELECT {dim} AS "维度", SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "工单完成率" FROM mes_work_order GROUP BY {dim} ORDER BY "工单完成率" DESC
description: 工单完成率（按工单张数）：order_status='completed' 的工单占全部工单的比例。yans 基准 60.17%（207/344）。与「计划达成率」不同——后者按数量算（78.31%），本口径按工单张数算。只算 completed，不含 closed，与内置「已完成工单数」保持同一分子口径。

name: 设备可用率
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN equipment_status = 'running' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
formula: 运行状态设备数 / 设备总数 × 100%
exec_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN equipment_status = 'running' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "设备可用率" FROM dim_equipment
exec_sql_by_dim: SELECT line_id AS "产线", SUM(CASE WHEN equipment_status = 'running' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "设备可用率" FROM dim_equipment GROUP BY line_id ORDER BY "设备可用率" DESC
description: 设备可用率（按设备状态）：equipment_status='running' 的设备占全部设备的比例。yans 基准 75.00%（36/48；36 运行 / 8 空闲 / 4 维护）。⚠ 这是「按状态」的可用率，**不等于 OEE 或设备利用率**——真正的利用率需要理论可用时间/计划开机时长，本库无该字段。

name: 设备故障停机占比
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '设备故障' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(downtime_minutes), 0)
formula: 设备故障停机时长 / 全部停机时长 × 100%
exec_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '设备故障' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(downtime_minutes), 0) AS "故障停机占比" FROM eqp_downtime_record
exec_sql_by_dim: SELECT {dim} AS "维度", SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '设备故障' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(downtime_minutes), 0) AS "故障停机占比" FROM eqp_downtime_record GROUP BY {dim} ORDER BY "故障停机占比" DESC
description: 设备故障停机占比：downtime_reason 恰为「设备故障」的停机时长占全部停机时长的比例。yans 基准 15.16%（2365/15600 分钟；设备故障 51 次）。⚠ 与「非计划停机占比」(52.72%) 是**两个不同概念**——后者含缺料等待/品质异常停线/换线调机等全部非计划原因，本口径只看「设备故障」单一原因，数值小得多（15.16% vs 52.72%），切勿互相冒充。

name: 检验批次合格率
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN inspection_result = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
formula: 合格批数 / 检验总批数 × 100%
exec_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN inspection_result = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "检验批次合格率" FROM qms_inspection
exec_sql_by_dim: SELECT {dim} AS "维度", SUM(CASE WHEN inspection_result = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "检验批次合格率" FROM qms_inspection GROUP BY {dim} ORDER BY "检验批次合格率" DESC
description: 检验批次合格率（按批）：inspection_result='pass' 的检验批占全部检验批的比例。yans 基准 52.54%（723/1376 批）。⚠ 与「质检合格率」(97.04%) 是**两个不同口径**——后者按抽检件数算 (sample_qty-defect_qty)/sample_qty，本口径按批次算，反映「有多少批整批合格」，通常远低于按件合格率。

name: 换线调机时长
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '换线调机' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END)
formula: Σ(停机原因=换线调机 的 downtime_minutes)
exec_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '换线调机' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "换线调机时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record
exec_sql_by_dim: SELECT {dim} AS "维度", SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '换线调机' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "换线调机时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record GROUP BY {dim} ORDER BY "换线调机时长" DESC
description: 换线调机停机时长：downtime_reason='换线调机' 的停机分钟数合计。yans 基准 3000 分钟（59 次，是次数最多的停机原因）。用于评估生产换型对设备可用的影响。

name: 缺料等待时长
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '缺料等待' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END)
formula: Σ(停机原因=缺料等待 的 downtime_minutes)
exec_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '缺料等待' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "缺料等待时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record
exec_sql_by_dim: SELECT {dim} AS "维度", SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '缺料等待' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "缺料等待时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record GROUP BY {dim} ORDER BY "缺料等待时长" DESC
description: 缺料等待停机时长：downtime_reason='缺料等待' 的停机分钟数合计。yans 基准 1920 分钟（45 次）。反映物料供应不及时造成的产线等待损失。

name: 品质异常停线时长
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '品质异常停线' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END)
formula: Σ(停机原因=品质异常停线 的 downtime_minutes)
exec_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '品质异常停线' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "品质异常停线时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record
exec_sql_by_dim: SELECT {dim} AS "维度", SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '品质异常停线' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "品质异常停线时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record GROUP BY {dim} ORDER BY "品质异常停线时长" DESC
description: 品质异常停线时长：downtime_reason='品质异常停线' 的停机分钟数合计。yans 基准 2005 分钟（40 次）。反映因质量问题导致的停线损失。

name: 各仓库库存量
sql_expression: SUM(available_qty + frozen_qty) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot))
formula: Σ(可用数量 + 冻结数量)，按仓库分组
exec_sql: SELECT warehouse_code AS "仓库", SUM(available_qty + frozen_qty) AS "库存量" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) GROUP BY warehouse_code ORDER BY "库存量" DESC

exec_sql_by_dim.仓库: SELECT warehouse_code AS "仓库", SUM(available_qty + frozen_qty) AS "库存量" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) GROUP BY warehouse_code ORDER BY "库存量" DESC

description: 各仓库库存量（最新快照日）：按 warehouse_code 汇总可用+冻结库存。yans 基准（最新快照日）WH-A 43187 / WH-B 21000 / WH-QA 9594 件。⚠ 口径是「最新快照日」而非全历史求和——inv_inventory_snapshot 是每日快照，直接 SUM 会重复累加。

name: 未完工工单数
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN order_status IN ('released','in_progress') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
formula: Σ(状态=已下达/进行中 的工单)
exec_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN order_status IN ('released','in_progress') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "未完工工单数" FROM mes_work_order
exec_sql_by_dim: SELECT {dim} AS "维度", SUM(CASE WHEN order_status IN ('released','in_progress') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "未完工工单数" FROM mes_work_order GROUP BY {dim} ORDER BY "未完工工单数" DESC
description: 未完工工单数：order_status 为 released（已下达）或 in_progress（进行中）的工单张数。yans 基准 65 单（released 32 + in_progress 33）。工单状态四态互斥且合计=总工单：completed(已完成 207) + closed(已取消/已关闭 72) + in_progress(33) + released(32) = 344。本口径 = released + in_progress，与「已完成工单数」「已取消工单数」互补，三者相加等于工单总数。

name: 缺货品种数
aliases: 哪些产品低于安全库存
sql_expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) AND available_qty < safety_stock_qty THEN product_id END)
formula: 最新快照日 available_qty < safety_stock_qty 的去重产品数
description: 缺货（低于安全库存）的产品品种数（口径：取最新快照日，available_qty < safety_stock_qty 的产品去重计数；yans 实测 2026-09-15 最新快照 20 个品种全部达标，缺货品种数 = 0）。与「满足安全库存品种数」互补，两者相加 = 最新快照覆盖品种数（20）。⚠️ 问「缺了多少件」是「库存缺口量」（件数口径），问「几种产品缺货」才是本口径，两者量纲不同禁止互相冒充。
exec_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS "缺货品种数" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) AND available_qty < safety_stock_qty

exec_sql_by_dim._default: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS "缺货品种数" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) AND available_qty < safety_stock_qty
exec_sql_by_dim.仓库: SELECT warehouse_code AS "仓库", COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS "缺货品种数" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) AND available_qty < safety_stock_qty GROUP BY warehouse_code ORDER BY "缺货品种数" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.产品: SELECT p.product_name AS "产品", i.available_qty AS "可用库存", i.safety_stock_qty AS "安全库存", (i.safety_stock_qty - i.available_qty) AS "缺口" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) AND i.available_qty < i.safety_stock_qty ORDER BY "缺口" DESC

name: 安全库存达标率
aliases: 安全库存达标率是多少
sql_expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) AND available_qty >= safety_stock_qty THEN product_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) THEN product_id END),0)
formula: 最新快照日达标品种数 / 最新快照覆盖品种数 × 100%
description: 安全库存达标率（按品种数算）：最新快照日 available_qty >= safety_stock_qty 的品种，占该快照覆盖品种数的比例。yans 实测 2026-09-15 最新快照 20/20 = 100.00%。⚠️ 与「计划达成率」（按产量件数算，78.31%）完全不同，切勿互相冒充；本口径只回答「有几个品种够不够」，不回答「缺多少件」（那是「库存缺口量」）。
exec_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.available_qty >= i.safety_stock_qty THEN i.product_id END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id),0),2) AS "安全库存达标率" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i WHERE i.snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot)

exec_sql_by_dim._default: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.available_qty >= i.safety_stock_qty THEN i.product_id END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id),0),2) AS "安全库存达标率" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i WHERE i.snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot)
exec_sql_by_dim.仓库: SELECT i.warehouse_code AS "仓库", ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.available_qty >= i.safety_stock_qty THEN i.product_id END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id),0),2) AS "安全库存达标率" FROM inv_inventory_snapshot i WHERE i.snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inv_inventory_snapshot) GROUP BY i.warehouse_code ORDER BY "安全库存达标率" DESC

name: 平均修复时长(MTTR)
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_planned = FALSE THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_planned = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
formula: 非计划停机时长 / 非计划停机次数（即每次非计划停机的平均修复耗时）
description: 平均修复时长 MTTR（口径：eqp_downtime_record 中 is_planned=FALSE 的停机分钟合计 ÷ 非计划停机次数；yans 实测 8225 ÷ 184 = 44.70 分钟/次）。⚠️ 与内置「平均停机时长」（全部 336 次停机平均 46.43 分钟）不是同一指标——后者含计划内停机（换线调机/计划保养/工装更换），本口径只算非计划（故障类）。
exec_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_planned=FALSE THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END)::numeric/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_planned=FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS "平均修复时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record

exec_sql_by_dim.产线: SELECT l.line_name AS "产线", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_planned=FALSE THEN d.downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END)::numeric/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_planned=FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS "平均修复时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record d JOIN dim_production_line l ON l.line_id=d.line_id GROUP BY l.line_name ORDER BY "平均修复时长" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.设备: SELECT e.equipment_name AS "设备", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_planned=FALSE THEN d.downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END)::numeric/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_planned=FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS "平均修复时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record d JOIN dim_equipment e ON e.equipment_id=d.equipment_id GROUP BY e.equipment_name ORDER BY "平均修复时长" DESC

name: 设备故障次数
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '设备故障' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
formula: Σ(停机原因 = 设备故障 的记录数)
description: 设备故障停机次数（口径：eqp_downtime_record 中 downtime_reason='设备故障' 的记录数；yans 实测 51 次，对应停机时长 2365 分钟，是 7 种停机原因里非计划类次数最多的一种）。⚠️ 与内置「非计划停机次数」（is_planned=FALSE 共 184 次）不同——后者含程序调试/缺料等待/品质异常停线等全部非计划原因；本口径只看「设备故障」这一个原因。
exec_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "设备故障次数" FROM eqp_downtime_record WHERE downtime_reason='设备故障'

exec_sql_by_dim.产线: SELECT l.line_name AS "产线", COUNT(*) AS "设备故障次数" FROM eqp_downtime_record d JOIN dim_production_line l ON l.line_id=d.line_id WHERE d.downtime_reason='设备故障' GROUP BY l.line_name ORDER BY "设备故障次数" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.设备: SELECT e.equipment_name AS "设备", COUNT(*) AS "设备故障次数" FROM eqp_downtime_record d JOIN dim_equipment e ON e.equipment_id=d.equipment_id WHERE d.downtime_reason='设备故障' GROUP BY e.equipment_name ORDER BY "设备故障次数" DESC

name: 保养停机时长
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '计划保养' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END)
formula: Σ(停机原因=计划保养 的 downtime_minutes)
description: 计划保养停机时长（口径：eqp_downtime_record 中 downtime_reason='计划保养' 的停机分钟合计；yans 实测 2585 分钟 / 54 次，是计划内停机里时长第二的原因，仅次于换线调机 3000 分钟）。⚠️ 与内置「计划内停机时长」（is_planned=TRUE 全部原因合计 7375 分钟 = 换线调机 3000 + 计划保养 2585 + 工装更换 1790）是包含关系——本口径只取「计划保养」单一原因。问「计划保养时长」会命中内置口径（7375 分钟），要看单一原因请用本口径。
exec_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason='计划保养' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "保养停机时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record

exec_sql_by_dim.产线: SELECT l.line_name AS "产线", SUM(CASE WHEN d.downtime_reason='计划保养' THEN d.downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "保养停机时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record d JOIN dim_production_line l ON l.line_id=d.line_id GROUP BY l.line_name ORDER BY "保养停机时长" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.设备: SELECT e.equipment_name AS "设备", SUM(CASE WHEN d.downtime_reason='计划保养' THEN d.downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "保养停机时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record d JOIN dim_equipment e ON e.equipment_id=d.equipment_id GROUP BY e.equipment_name ORDER BY "保养停机时长" DESC

name: 程序调试时长
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '程序调试' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END)
formula: Σ(停机原因=程序调试 的 downtime_minutes)
description: 程序调试停机时长（口径：eqp_downtime_record 中 downtime_reason='程序调试' 的停机分钟合计；yans 实测 1935 分钟 / 48 次，属非计划停机）。与已登记的「换线调机时长」「缺料等待时长」「品质异常停线时长」「保养停机时长」「工装更换时长」同为「按停机原因拆分时长」的同族口径，七种原因时长合计 = 全部停机时长 15600 分钟。
exec_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason='程序调试' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "程序调试时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record

exec_sql_by_dim.产线: SELECT l.line_name AS "产线", SUM(CASE WHEN d.downtime_reason='程序调试' THEN d.downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "程序调试时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record d JOIN dim_production_line l ON l.line_id=d.line_id GROUP BY l.line_name ORDER BY "程序调试时长" DESC
exec_sql_by_dim.设备: SELECT e.equipment_name AS "设备", SUM(CASE WHEN d.downtime_reason='程序调试' THEN d.downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS "程序调试时长" FROM eqp_downtime_record d JOIN dim_equipment e ON e.equipment_id=d.equipment_id GROUP BY e.equipment_name ORDER BY "程序调试时长" DESC

name: 工装更换时长
sql_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN downtime_reason = '工装更换' THEN downtime_minutes ELSE 0 END)
formula: Σ(停机原因=工装更换 的 downtime_minutes)
description: 工装更换停机时长（口径：eqp_downtime_record 中 downtime_reason='工装更换' 的停机分钟合计；yans 实测 1790 分钟 / 39 次，属计划内停机，是七种原因中时长最短的一种）。与「换线调机时长」（3000 分钟 / 59 次）是不同的停机原因，勿合并计算。

formula: 按工序比对：实际良率 = good_qty / input_qty；标准良率 = dim_process.standard_yield_rate（存储为小数，×100 归一为百分数）；实际 < 标准 即未达标，统计未达标工序道数
description: 实际良率低于该工序标准良率的工序道数（口径：先按 process_id 分组算实际良率 good_qty/input_qty，再与 dim_process.standard_yield_rate×100 比较，实际 < 标准 计为未达标）。yans 实测共 8 道工序：未达标 6 道（功能测试 95.80<96.50 / 老化测试 96.20<96.80 / 波峰焊 96.57<97.00 / 插件装配 97.11<97.50 / 回流焊 97.94<98.20 / SMT贴片 98.28<98.50），达标 2 道（AOI检测 99.19≥99.00 / 包装入库 99.21≥99.20）。⚠️ 与内置「标准良率」（取各工序标准值的 MAX = 99.20%）不是同一指标，也与内置「良率」（全厂 97.56%）不同——本口径是「工序达标情况」的计数。
exec_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT p.process_id, SUM(f.good_qty)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(f.input_qty),0) AS act, p.standard_yield_rate*100 AS std FROM mes_process_output f JOIN dim_process p ON f.process_id=p.process_id GROUP BY p.process_id, p.standard_yield_rate) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE act < std) AS "低于标准良率工序数", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE act >= std) AS "达标工序数", COUNT(*) AS "总工序数" FROM x
